## Evidence

- [ ] `npm run format`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass

- [ ] No secret, PII or full credential in code, logs or tests
- [ ] New persisted fields have a dated backfill
- [ ] `ai-platform-frontend/docs/implemented-features.md` updated where a phase landed
- [ ] Breaking change called out

## Review

- [ ] Copilot review requested (`gh pr edit <n> --add-reviewer "@copilot"`), every comment fixed or answered, every thread resolved
- [ ] Human reviewer requested
